name: SMAC / SMACv2
description: StarCraft Multi-Agent Challenge (SMAC) is a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning benchmark built on the StarCraft II game engine, where teams of units must coordinate to defeat an enemy army controlled by the built-in AI. SMACv2 introduces procedurally generated scenarios to address overfitting to fixed maps and increase generalisation difficulty.
typical_sota_score: SMAC: >90% win rate on most maps for top algorithms; SMACv2 harder with lower saturated baselines.
reputation: The most widely used cooperative MARL benchmark in academic research; standard testbed for decentralised multi-agent algorithms.
notes: SMAC has near-saturation on easy/medium maps; SMACv2 was designed to address this. Requires StarCraft II installation.
